versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Example Prompts to SKILL.md, Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md

- Initial release of school-locker-setup-map.
- Helps students and caregivers design a practical locker layout with zones, supply list, label plan, and routines.
- Emphasizes privacy and safety—keeps valuables and private schedules off visible labels.
- Provides a workflow for setup, maintenance, routines, troubleshooting, and photo checklist.
- Output includes a clear format: locker snapshot, zone map, supply list, routines, checklist, and troubleshooting tips.
